description: Source code implementing ECDSA signature creation and verification functions, including ASN.1 encoding/decoding, specific to OpenSSL's cryptographic library.

methods.name: ECDSA_sign
methods.description: Signs a digest using ECDSA, producing a signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_verify
methods.description: Verifies an ECDSA signature against a digest.

methods.name: ECDSA_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of an ECDSA signature for a given key.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_parse
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 encoded ECDSA signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_from_bytes
methods.description: Creates an ECDSA_SIG structure from raw bytes.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_marshal
methods.description: Serializes an ECDSA_SIG structure into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts an ECDSA_SIG structure into DER-encoded bytes.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_max_len
methods.description: Calculates maximum length of an ECDSA signature based on key size.

methods.name: d2i_ECDSA_SIG
methods.description: Decodes DER-encoded bytes into an ECDSA_SIG structure.

methods.name: i2d_ECDSA_SIG
methods.description: Encodes an ECDSA_SIG structure into DER format.
